WITH comm_data AS (
    SELECT 
        c.commregistry,
        c.vpnflag,
        c.langpattern,
        c.msgtally,
        c.iptally,
        c.tornodecount,
        c.brwsrunique,
        c.susppatscore,
        c.riskindiccount,
        -- VPN numeric mapping
        CASE 
            WHEN c.vpnflag = 'Yes' THEN 1
            WHEN c.vpnflag = 'Suspected' THEN 0.5
            ELSE 0
        END AS vpnflag_numeric,
        -- Language pattern numeric mapping
        CASE 
            WHEN c.langpattern = 'Consistent' THEN 1
            WHEN c.langpattern = 'Variable' THEN 2
            WHEN c.langpattern = 'Suspicious' THEN 3
            ELSE 0
        END AS langpattern_numeric
    FROM communication c
),
risk_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        *,
        -- CSR calculation
        ROUND(CAST(
            (iptally * 5) + (tornodecount * 2) + (vpnflag_numeric * 30) + (brwsrunique / 10.0) + (susppatscore * 3) + (riskindiccount * 4)
        AS numeric), 2) AS csr_score,
        -- CPR calculation
        ROUND(CAST(
            (langpattern_numeric * 15) + (((iptally * 5) + (tornodecount * 2) + (vpnflag_numeric * 30) + (brwsrunique / 10.0) + (susppatscore * 3) + (riskindiccount * 4)) * 0.2) + (msgtally * 0.5) - (1 - vpnflag_numeric) * 20
        AS numeric), 2) AS cpr_score
    FROM comm_data
)
SELECT 
    commregistry,
    vpnflag,
    langpattern,
    msgtally,
    csr_score,
    cpr_score,
    CASE 
        WHEN cpr_score > 70 AND langpattern = 'Suspicious' AND csr_score > 80 
        THEN 'Deceptive Pattern'
        ELSE 'Normal Pattern'
    END AS pattern_type
FROM risk_calc
ORDER BY cpr_score DESC;
